title: RMIT University Student Services Update 4
content: RMIT Vietnam announces new student support services for the upcoming semester. The university is expanding its library resources, adding 24/7 study spaces, and introducing a new online portal for course registration. Students can now access digital resources including academic journals, e-books, and research databases through the updated library system. Financial aid applications for the next semester are now open. Eligible students can apply for scholarships covering up to 50 percent of tuition fees. The student accommodation office has also released new housing options near the Saigon South campus. For more information, visit the RMIT student portal or contact student services directly.
